def evaluate(p,save=False,details=False):

 lo,hi=m.actuator_ctrlrange.T
 start=d.qpos[7:26].copy()
 # knots: hip pitch,knee,ankle,common hiproll, differential hiproll, yaw, hip asym
 ps=np.asarray(p[:21]).reshape(3,7)
 times=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.clip(p[21:24],5,90))]

 for hip,knee,ankle,roll,spread,yaw,asym in ps:

  q[[1,6]]=[roll+spread,roll-spread];q[[0,5]]=yaw
  qs.append(q)
 qs=np.array(qs)
 actions=[];total=0;aux=0;logs=[]
 for t in range(1000):
  k=min(2,np.searchsorted(times[1:],t,side='right'))
  f=np.clip((t-times[k])/(times[k+1]-times[k]),0,1)
  q=qs[k]*(1-f)+qs[k+1]*f
  a=np.clip(2*(q-lo)/(hi-lo)-1,-1,1).astype(np.float32)

  pos=d.qpos[:3];chair=d.xpos[23];rot=d.xmat[23].reshape(3,3);local=rot.T@(pos-chair)
